queryLines:
SELECT
    make_date(year, month, day) AS trip_date,
    taxi_type,
    PULocationID AS pickup_zone_id,
    DOLocationID AS dropoff_zone_id,
    coalesce(pickup_borough, 'Unknown') AS pickup_borough,
    concat(coalesce(pickup_zone, 'Unknown'), ' [', CAST(PULocationID AS STRING), ']') AS pickup_zone,
    coalesce(dropoff_borough, 'Unknown') AS dropoff_borough,
    concat(coalesce(dropoff_zone, 'Unknown'), ' [', CAST(DOLocationID AS STRING), ']') AS dropoff_zone,
    concat(
        coalesce(pickup_zone, 'Unknown'), ' [', CAST(PULocationID AS STRING), '] → ',
        coalesce(dropoff_zone, 'Unknown'), ' [', CAST(DOLocationID AS STRING), ']'
    ) AS route,
    trip_count,
    total_passenger_charges,
    total_tips,
    charge_trip_count,
    tip_trip_count,
    distance_trip_count,
    duration_trip_count,
    total_trip_duration_minutes,
    distance_charge_total,
    charge_distance,
    total_trip_distance,
    credit_card_trip_count,
    cash_trip_count,
    credit_card_fare_total,
    credit_card_tip_total
FROM daily_route_metrics

columns.description: Average recorded tip for trips with a recorded tip amount
Share of all trips paid by credit card; denominator is all trips
Average miles for trips with a recorded distance
Average minutes for trips with a recorded duration
Passenger charges per mile for trips with both values
Recorded tips divided by fares on card trips with both values and a positive aggregate fare
columns.expression: CASE WHEN SUM(credit_card_fare_total) > 0 THEN SUM(credit_card_tip_total) / SUM(credit_card_fare_total) END
